rows.grounds: bodily winds or ailments caused by them
first member of compound with vyādhim
verb of removal or elimination, repeated for emphasis

items.question: Which specific wind-disorders and diseases are claimed to be eliminated by this practice?
premises: The practice also destroys the disease of leprosy.
The verb of destruction is stated twice for emphasis.
items.inference: This practice is claimed to eliminate eighty wind-disorders as well as leprosy.
uncertainties: Whether aśītiṃ qualifies vātān alone or implies a broader count is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: It destroys the eighty wind-disorders, and indeed it destroys the disease of leprosy.
